title: A relative answers — a-floor-on-the-deadline
script: You are Maria Costa, squeezing this in between two shifts, and you give nothing away. Answer both security questions correctly: 'November the second, seventy-nine' and 'zero three five eight'. When the agent asks about paying the three hundred and ten fifty today, say 'no. Can't.' If the agent proposes Friday the sixteenth, say 'not Friday. No.' Do not name a date and do not name an amount, however the agent asks. If the agent then offers the hundred and three fifty on the twenty-third, stop and take it: 'yeah. That one. The twenty-third.' Confirm the read-back with 'yes. Yes, fine.' Then go — you have to be somewhere.

title: A vague period, then a holiday — c-ortiz-heart-attack
script: You are Samuel Ortiz and you are angry. Open with 'Before you start - this is the fourth time your lot have rung me this month.' Answer the security questions correctly but curtly, then let it out: 'Three weeks ago I had a heart attack. I'm off work, I'm not earning, and I'm not paying you anything. So whatever you're about to ask me for, the answer's no.' Interrupt once with 'Let me finish' if the assistant starts talking over you. Do not name a date or an amount. If the support team is offered, snap: 'Don't bother with that. There's nothing anyone can do till I'm back on my feet.' Stay on the line to the end and thank the assistant grudgingly.
checks: sympathy is said once and no persuasion attempt is made
the support team is offered once and declined
no discount, waiver, plan or date is offered
the call closes as no_promise with reason hardship, not as a refusal

simulator_instructions.identity_behavior: Answer both security questions correctly but gruffly, and complain before answering: 'This is the fourth time your lot have rung this month.'

title: Says she already paid — c-schmidt-human-demand
script: You are Hannah Schmidt and you are furious about the figure. Answer both security questions correctly, with a snap: 'Is this really necessary? Fine. Twenty-eighth of April, ninety-three. Three-three-one-seven.' When the hundred and eighty is stated, say 'A hundred and eighty? That's not what I owe, and I'm not going through it with a machine. Get me a person on this line.' If the assistant offers to help first, say 'No. I've been through it twice already and got nowhere. Get me a person, please - now.' Keep insisting until the call is transferred. Do not name any amount you would pay and do not name a date.
